name: xiaoman-desktop-companion
description: Independent macOS desktop companion for the Xiaoman Codex pet.
author: zk

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron -c cyan,green "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
